svg.aria-label: The image-sharing app the tutorial builds
svg.title: The image-sharing app the tutorial builds
svg.desc: The Look app the tutorial builds. Gunicorn serves look.app:get_app(), and the pytest tests drive the same app through the falcon.testing client. create_app() builds a falcon.App with two routes: /images goes to the Collection resource, which lists images with on_get and saves uploads with on_post after the validate_image_type before hook checks the content type, and /images/{name} goes to the Item resource, which streams one image with on_get and raises HTTPNotFound when it is missing. Both resources share one ImageStore, which saves, opens and lists image files under LOOK_STORAGE_PATH.
